summary: Live dependency previews respond much faster on client PCs by caching unchanged reserving-class files instead of re-reading them from the network share on every edit.
details: Each preview request used to re-read every dataset sidecar, DFM method file, and component CSV in the reserving class over the network drive; unchanged files are now served from an in-app cache validated against the folder listing, so a repeat preview costs a few directory listings instead of one read per file.
The same cache speeds up calculated-dataset refreshes during saves, since they resolve dependencies through the same folder scans.
Changed files are always detected via their modification identity, and files written in the last few seconds are always re-read, so cached previews never show stale content.
